about: Black & Gold Dispatch staff scouting tiers. Our own judgment, formed after reading many public scouting reports and news stories, then deciding for ourselves. Tiers are broad buckets, not a rank order, and the reasons are our own words. Nothing here is copied from any outside board.

players.name: Jeremiah Smith
players.reason: Rare size-speed WR who wins every way; the class's best player in our view.

players.name: Colin Simmons
players.reason: Explosive first step and steady sack production; needs more bulk against the run.

players.name: Leonard Moore
players.reason: Sticky press-man corner who rarely gets targeted; recent concussion worth watching.

players.name: Darian Mensah
players.reason: Elite accuracy and timing on three straight productive college stops; arm strength and frame are the questions.

players.name: Dante Moore
players.reason: Big frame and arm with real upside; uneven 2026 and a concussion keep him from being a lock.

players.name: Trevor Goosby
players.reason: Long, athletic left tackle who has looked like a pro starter against top competition.

players.name: Jordan Seaton
players.reason: Smooth pass protector with a timed punch; run blocking is improving but still behind.

players.name: Dylan Stewart
players.reason: Long, twitchy rusher with a high ceiling; injury, suspension and thin sack totals add risk.

players.name: Arch Manning
players.reason: Tools and pedigree are obvious, but the 2026 tape has been erratic; could easily return to school.

players.name: Cam Coleman
players.reason: Big-play size and speed; hasn't dominated games yet in a shaky passing offense.

players.name: Charlie Becker
players.reason: Productive, reliable receiver who keeps winning against Big Ten coverage.

players.name: Drew Mestemaker
players.reason: Late bloomer with a big arm and good pocket patience; short track record.

players.name: Ellis Robinson IV
players.reason: Fluid, ball-hawking corner; slight frame is the main knock.

players.name: Will Echoles
players.reason: Heavy-handed interior lineman who collapses the pocket and holds up against the run.

players.name: David Stone
players.reason: Quick, disruptive tackle with former top-recruit traits now showing up on tape.

players.name: A'Mauri Washington
players.reason: Long, athletic interior defender with versatility to play multiple spots.

players.name: Trinidad Chambliss
players.reason: Creative playmaker with a live arm; age and smaller build will cap where he goes.

players.name: KJ Bolden
players.reason: Rangy, physical safety who can play deep or in the box.

players.name: Yhonzae Pierre
players.reason: Bendy speed rusher with growing production in the SEC.

players.name: Jadan Baugh
players.reason: Powerful every-down back; running back value keeps him out of our top tier.

players.name: Kelley Jones
players.reason: Long corner with ball production; needs to tighten up his technique.

players.name: Devan Thompkins
players.reason: Big, long-armed defensive lineman who sheds blocks well; pass rush still developing.

players.name: Justin Scott
players.reason: Powerful interior defender who lives in the backfield when healthy.

players.name: Jamari Johnson
players.reason: Big target at tight end who can block and stretch the middle.

players.name: CJ Carr
players.reason: Accurate, poised passer; likely benefits from another college season.

players.name: Nick Marsh
players.reason: Strong-handed possession receiver with big production.

players.name: Chris Cole
players.reason: Fast, instinctive linebacker who shows up all over the stat sheet.

players.name: Xavier Gilliam
players.reason: Stout, active defensive tackle with growing pass-rush flashes.

players.name: Ashton Hampton
players.reason: Physical corner with good size; consistency is the next step.

players.name: Brauntae Johnson
players.reason: Versatile safety who reads plays quickly; limited 2026 data so far.

players.name: Trevor Lauck
players.reason: Polished, tough lineman from a program that produces pros up front.

players.name: Greg Johnson
players.reason: Experienced interior lineman with strong hands and good balance.

players.name: Zereoue Williams
players.reason: Big, athletic tackle with upside from a strong O-line program.

players.name: Ryan Coleman-Williams
players.reason: Explosive, sudden receiver who creates separation.

players.name: Matayo Uiagalelei
players.reason: Powerful edge with a big frame and steady pressure numbers.

players.name: Trey'Dez Green
players.reason: Huge, athletic tight end with red-zone upside.

players.name: Kewan Lacy
players.reason: Productive, slashing back; position value caps him in our view.

players.name: Lance Heard
players.reason: Massive tackle with starter traits; needs more consistency.

players.name: Cayden Green
players.reason: Strong, versatile lineman who can play tackle or guard.

players.name: Carter Smith
players.reason: Reliable pass protector on a winning offense.

players.name: Ahmad Moten Sr.
players.reason: Big run-stopping tackle with some pass-rush juice.

players.name: Mark Fletcher Jr.
players.reason: Big, physical back who finishes runs; durability to monitor.

players.name: Samson Okunlola
players.reason: Huge, clean pass protector at left tackle this season; still raw in spots.

players.name: Damon Wilson II
players.reason: Long, quick edge rusher with real sack production at two stops.

players.name: Will Heldt
players.reason: Long, high-motor edge who keeps getting home.

players.name: Zabien Brown
players.reason: Instinctive corner with ball skills; needs more size.

players.name: KJ Duff
players.reason: Big-bodied deep threat with growing production.

players.name: Sammy Brown
players.reason: Fast, physical linebacker who makes plays behind the line.

players.name: Jacarrius Peak
players.reason: Athletic tackle prospect with good length.

players.name: Melvin Siani
players.reason: Big, strong lineman with experience on a top line.

players.name: LaNorris Sellers
players.reason: Rare runner and big arm at QB; accuracy and reads still inconsistent.

players.name: Julian Sayin
players.reason: Accurate, efficient passer with elite weapons; needs to show more arm and size.

players.name: Gunner Stockton
players.reason: Tough, efficient game manager; average tools for the NFL.

players.name: Avery Johnson
players.reason: Dangerous runner; passing consistency is the question.

players.name: Conner Weigman
players.reason: Big production this year, but injuries and a lower level of play temper our view.

players.name: Dylan Raiola
players.reason: Talented former top recruit who needs playing time to rebuild his stock.

players.name: Marquise Lightfoot
players.reason: Quick, active rusher; needs more size and consistency.

players.name: Jordan Ross
players.reason: Athletic, long edge with upside; production still catching up.

players.name: Kenyatta Jackson Jr.
players.reason: Big, strong edge setter with improving pass rush.

players.name: Peyton Bowen
players.reason: Instinctive, experienced DB with good ball production.

players.name: Duce Robinson
players.reason: Huge receiver with a big catch radius; route running still developing.

players.name: Tunmise Adeleye
players.reason: Productive, powerful edge; level of competition is a question.

players.name: Kam Franklin
players.reason: Productive rusher who needs to show more versatility.

players.name: Elijah Paige
players.reason: Long tackle with physical tools; consistency needed.

players.name: Earnest Greene III
players.reason: Experienced, strong lineman from an elite program.

players.name: Ian Moore
players.reason: Big tackle with the frame scouts like; still developing.

players.name: Fox Crader
players.reason: Solid, smart lineman on a deep Oregon front.

note_pos: Optional 'pos' fixes a roster position label (e.g. a stand-up rusher listed as LB).
